MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL: normal volatility at 30.4% and mixed breadth, with 4/8 sectors positive over 1W. Positioning favors select leaders over broad market exposure.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation leads (+3.98% 1W; +16.93% 1M), with PGSUS (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +21.72%) ABOVE TREND and THYAO (1W: +4.35% | 1M: +16.89%) ABOVE TREND. Heavy Industry (+2.57% 1W) and Construction & REIT (+2.47%) also advanced, though monthly sector returns remain negative.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Holding & Investment is weakest (-4.78% 1W; -2.85% 1M), with DOHOL (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND. Banking & Finance (-1.98% 1W) and Energy & Chemicals (-1.62%) are also soft; GUBRF (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -26.43%) is BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
VESTL (1W: +17.26% | 1M: -12.38%) RECOVERY; ALARK (1W: +8.92% | 1M: -1.47%) RECOVERY; PGSUS (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +21.72%) ABOVE TREND. TUPRS (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -7.41%) RECOVERY; CCOLA (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
ULKER (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -10.04%) BELOW TREND; DOHOL (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND; SOKM (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -23.03%) BELOW TREND. HEKTS (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; GUBRF (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -26.43%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest weekly advances include VESTL (1W: +17.26% | 1M: -12.38%) RECOVERY and ALARK (1W: +8.92% | 1M: -1.47%) RECOVERY. PGSUS (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +21.72%) is ABOVE TREND, while TUPRS (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -7.41%) is RECOVERY.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance fell 1.98% over 1W despite a 2.92% 1M gain; leading monthly names are now in CORRECTION. AKBNK (1W: -1.48% | 1M: +2.79%), GARAN (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +12.10%), ISCTR (1W: -2.63% | 1M: +1.83%) and YKBNK (1W: -3.25% | 1M: +3.25%) are all CORRECTION.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry rose 2.57% over 1W but remains down 6.28% over 1M, signaling a rebound against a weaker monthly trend. VESTL (1W: +17.26% | 1M: -12.38%) is RECOVERY, ASELS (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +0.57%) is ABOVE TREND, while EREGL (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -13.85%) is BELOW TREND and FROTO (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +3.18%) is CORRECTION.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector declined 1.62% over 1W and 12.16% over 1M, with dispersion between a short-term rebound and persistent weakness. TUPRS (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -7.41%) is RECOVERY; GUBRF (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -26.43%) and HEKTS (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -18.27%) are BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a neutral, selective stance: favor confirmed leaders and keep exposure diversified while breadth remains mixed. Avoid chasing sharp rebounds without improvement in monthly trends; manage downside in persistent laggards.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
PGSUS (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +21.72%) ABOVE TREND and THYAO (1W: +4.35% | 1M: +16.89%) ABOVE TREND for continuation; monitor follow-through in VESTL (1W: +17.26% | 1M: -12.38%) RECOVERY. TUPRS (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -7.41%) RECOVERY is a rebound watch, while GUBRF (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -26.43%) BELOW TREND remains a downside-risk gauge.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Track Transportation for continuation after the strongest weekly and monthly sector returns, and Heavy Industry for evidence its short-term rebound can reverse monthly weakness. Energy & Chemicals remains a downside-risk watch given its weak 1M performance.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 spot, support and resistance levels were not provided, so specific index levels cannot be set from this dataset. Watch for breadth to expand beyond 4/8 positive sectors and for sector leaders to sustain gains; a volatility rise above 40% would increase risk.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL conditions persist, with 30.4% volatility and mixed 4/8 breadth; Transportation is the clearest area of strength, while Holding & Investment and Energy & Chemicals lag. Favor selective exposure to confirmed leaders, and treat recovery names cautiously until their monthly trends improve.
